answer: Each AI juror posts its performance score to a public jetty on the ledger; every new block computes the median nebula of all scores and compares each juror’s latest vote to that median. If a juror’s divergence exceeds the nadir threshold, an automatic slashing transaction burns 25 % of the juror’s staked tokens and locks the remaining 75 % for 30 days, making any Sybil node pay 0.25 × stake per fake identity. The attacker must therefore front‑lock the full stake for every replica and forfeit a quarter, driving the cost to 0.25 × stake + 30‑day lock per identity.
